test_gtest_list_tests: run the script with --gtest_list_tests to list available googletest test cases
test_gtest_filter_pass: run the script with --gtest_filter=FirstTest.subTestA to execute a passing test
test_gtest_filter_fail: run the script with --gtest_filter=FirstTest.subTestB to execute a failing test
test_gtest_parameterized: run the script with --gtest_filter=ParameterizedTest/0.subTest to execute a parameterized test
test_gtest_invalid_args: run the script with invalid arguments to verify error handling for unexpected args
